name: SD.cpp Studio style templates
description: Curated style templates for generation. Each style has just two fields: prompt and negative_prompt. In prompt, use the {prompt} placeholder where your own prompt should go; if you omit it, the template is simply prepended to your prompt. The negative_prompt is appended to your negative prompt. Edit this file to add, change, or remove styles. Click Reload in the app after editing.

styles.prompt: anime illustration, clean line art, cel shading, vibrant colors, expressive eyes, studio quality anime key visual, highly detailed, {prompt}
styles.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, deformed
